Entries.Original: I would never have guessed Aoi was the last surviving member of the 29th generation of squads... We probably could've gotten some interesting intel from her.
I can't believe I missed something that important... But we've already promised not to interfere, so our hands are tied.
Yep... We need to leave 31-B alone for now.
Once the battle's over, we can all go back to being friendly again.
Precisely! Let's fight to bring peace to the world for that future!
